title: Service Dependency Registry
description: Authoritative registry of inter-service prerequisites across government workflows.

dependencies.description: Holding an effective Learner's Licence for at least 30 days is a statutory prerequisite before applying for a permanent Driving Licence (Motor Vehicles Act 1988 §9(3), CMVR 1989 Rule 14).
Registration of the husband's death and issuance of an official Death Certificate is a prerequisite for a Widow Certificate (RBD Act 1969, Karnataka Revenue Department).
Prior LMV Driving Licence held for at least one year is required if applying for a Transport vehicle Learner's Licence (Motor Vehicles Act 1988 §7(1)).
